summary: Dreamforce 2026 delivered a wave of announcements defining the next era of enterprise AI — from Salesforce’s own reasoning model, Koa, to new agentic capabilities spanning sales, service, government, and industry. body_markdown:
Dreamforce 2026 delivered a wave of announcements defining the next era of enterprise AI — from Salesforce’s own reasoning model, Koa, to new agentic capabilities spanning sales, service, government, and industry. Below, the essential rundown for leaders tracking where agentic AI is headed and what it means for the enterprise.


Salesforce's own reasoning model:


Salesforce built Koa, its new reasoning model, by post-training NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Super on thousands of simulated enterprise scenarios rather than generic internet data. Jayesh Govindarajan, EVP, Software Engineering, and Silvio Savarese, EVP, Chief Scientist, explain why governed, repeatable work favors a model trained on the exact work at hand — one that applies consistent rules instead of reasoning from scratch — and knows when to hand off to a human. Koa already runs internal Salesforce workflows and is now in customer pilots for service, sales, and commerce agents.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fwhy-we-post-trained-our-own-reasoning-model%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=caq6&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Agent-Empowered Showers:


The Grout Guy is using agents to automate the admin behind scheduling, quoting, lead management, and technician preparation, allowing their team to spend more time looking after customers. Since implementing Salesforce, the company has seen, on average, a 20% increase in quote conversion rate.


[Watch the clip.](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:ugcPost:7506079695839420416/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Transforming the retail experience:


In this video from Dreamforce’s Agentic Enterprise City, see how AT&T used what it dubbed the Agent Briefing to give sales reps bullet points on their customers, shifting the time it takes to upgrade a phone in a store from 30 minutes to 10 minutes.


Secrets from Early Adopters:


This interview highlights how two companies — Box and Engine — are leveraging AI to transform their operations. Box integrates Salesforce data and its own unstructured content directly into Slack, allowing deal teams to access comprehensive customer information without switching between different user interfaces. Engine is working with new reasoning models that Salesforce is developing to handle complex, multi-system issues like travel disruptions and automatic dispute resolution.


[Watch the clip.](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7506383434676707329/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Everything your agents need, in one place.


The AgentExchange ecosystem has always included apps. Now, the Headless Toolkit is opening it to new kinds of partners. Companies behind AI-native work apps, builders, developer environments, and cloud platforms are using this toolkit to bring Salesforce into their own products. These partners give your teams and agents more places to create, collaborate, and take action.


[Learn more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fagentexchange%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fdf26-announcements&urlhash=5IUb&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Rock ’n Rollout:


At BottleRock Napa Valley, a weekend of music alongside food, wine, and culinary experiences, fans are constantly deciding what to see, where to go, and what to do next. To help fans arrive prepared and make it easier to discover everything the festival had to offer, Live Nation debuted Melody: an agentic festival guide providing on-demand expertise powered by


[Service Cloud](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fservice%2F%3Fd%3Dcta-body-promo-8&urlhash=IXQf&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


. Today at Dreamforce, Salesforce and Live Nation Entertainment announced an expansion of Live Nation’s use of


[Agentforce](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fagentforce%2F%3Fd%3Dcta-body-promo-8&urlhash=GwIT&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


, bringing 24/7 fan support to Live Nation venues across the U.S.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F16%2Flive-nation-agentforce-expansion%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=UBui&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Mission: AI-Possible:


Salesforce today announced new


[Missionforce](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fgovernment%2F%3Fd%3Dcta-body-promo-8&urlhash=8P_G&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


capabilities that give government agencies greater control over how they develop, customize, and deploy AI. Salesforce also announced a new Missionforce partnership with OpenAI to bring its leading AI models to secure government environments. The partnerships will unlock immediate operational impact: decision clarity for operators in the field; greater efficiency and mission readiness for agencies; and faster, more responsive services for citizens.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fmissionsforce-expansion-agents-nvidia-openai-partnerships%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=D9N5&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


One Year AI-niversary:


Today Salesforce marks one year of Missionforce, its agentic platform for government that brings trusted AI, data, apps, and cloud technology to the government’s most critical missions. Since the launch, the public sector has become Salesforce’s fastest-growing industry business at scale, with its defense sector business growing 80% year over year as demand accelerates.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fmissionsforce-one-year-anniversary%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=jUdj&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Salesforce Wherever You Are:


Salesforce introduced AIforce, a live interface layer that brings the enterprise knowledge inside Salesforce — the data, workflows, business logic, semantics, permissions, security and governance that already run the business — to any agentic platform. With AIforce, people don’t have to come to Salesforce to get work done. Salesforce comes to them – in Claude,


[Slack](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fslack%2Ecom%2F&urlhash=QZp5&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


, Lightning, or wherever they want to work. Employees who have never opened a dashboard can now ask questions, update records, and trigger workflows, all grounded in real Salesforce data and business logic. And agents can unlock trapped value: reading across hundreds of records at once, pulling in connected systems, and reasoning and taking action, at a speed and scale no human ever could.


[Read more](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Faiforce-announcement%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=X980&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


.


Koa Knows:


Salesforce and NVIDIA today announced Koa, Salesforce’s first CRM reasoning model for Agentforce. Built on NVIDIA Nemotron, and developed through deep technical collaboration with NVIDIA, Koa is designed to help agents reason through complex, multistep workflows and use the right tools to get work done. Koa was built by post-training the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super model with a proprietary synthetic dataset modeled on enterprise knowledge from nearly three decades of CRM deployments. The result is a reasoning model grounded in how businesses run — their processes, workflows, and operational policies.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F15%2Fkoa-reasoning-model%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=xYBp&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Rohan Kumar, President, Chief Platform & Engineering Officer, Salesforce introduces Koa at the Dreamforce 2026 keynote.


Industrial Strength Partnership:


Salesforce and Siemens, a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, mobility, and healthcare, are combining Agentforce with Siemens’ Teamcenter Service Lifecycle Management to put engineering-grade answers directly into sales, service and customer workflows. The result is a new level of industrial intelligence in the front office. Agentforce also qualifies every inbound lead for Siemens’ 18,000 sellers, converting inbound interest into productive sales conversations and revenue growth.


[Read more](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F15%2Fsiemens-agentforce-redefine-industrial-sales-service%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=EaW2&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


.


Trailblazers Turn Twenty!


Salesforce’s Trailblazer Community — a global crew of millions of people who build, customize, and govern Salesforce technology for other companies — turns 20 this year. When the ecosystem was first launched, SaaS technology was still in its infancy, and these administrators and developers came together to learn new skills, share best practices, and support each other in their career journey. And now that AI and agents are changing the way we work, Trailblazers will lead this new shift in helping companies figure out how to adapt.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Ftrailblazers-twentieth-anniversary%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=Axng&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


AWSome Alliance:


Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Salesforce have expanded their collaboration with new integrations to make it easier for teams to work across AWS and Salesforce within established workflows. With these integrations, a sales team will be able to prep for a meeting in Amazon Quick with live CRM data, a service agent can route a customer issue across Agentforce and Amazon Connect Customer seamlessly, and an ops team can query data across both environments.


[Read more](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Faws-salesforce-enterprise-ai-expansion%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=uTpb&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


.


Cloud Collab:


Salesforce and Google Cloud have expanded their strategic partnership: By running Salesforce on Google Cloud infrastructure and connecting Salesforce’s headless architecture with Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise, agents on either platform can reason and act upon the same data without custom integrations. Google Cloud is one of the first hyperscalers to implement Salesforce’s headless architecture, enabling customers to deploy intelligent workflows across their sales, service, and productivity tools with uncompromised security and scale.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fsalesforce-google-cloud-unify-infrastructure-and-agents%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=xqjz&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


## Recommended by LinkedIn


[The Agentic Enterprise Is Here — 7 Big Takeaways from… Gaurav Pratap Singh 6 months ago](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/agentic-enterprise-here-7-big-takeaways-from-tdx-2026-pratap-singh-zgdmf)


[Top 9 Insights From Dreamforce 2026: Every CXO Needs… Sateesh Chandrashekhar 1 month ago](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/top-9-insights-from-dreamforce-2026-every-cxo-needs-chandrashekhar-s9nrf)


[Why Context is the Star of Salesforce TDX This Year Corey Litwin 7 months ago](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/why-context-star-salesforce-tdx-year-corey-litwin-x5dmc)


The campground opens for Dreamforce 2026.


Hello, My Name Is:


Salesforce’s new job-ready agents (


[Casey](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fservice%2Fcustomer-self-service%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=kv5v&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


,


[Piper](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Equalified%2Ecom%2Fconversations&urlhash=FuKO&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


,


[Hunter](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fsales%2Fai-sales-agent%2Foutbound%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=bwEl&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


, and more) are specifically built to take on high-value work across sales, service, commerce, employee experience, and the back office. Crucially, some of the most valuable work in a business can’t be completed in a single conversation. That’s why Salesforce built a new long-horizon runtime for Agentforce, enabling agents to pursue goals across days and weeks instead of completing only a task or interaction. Hunter is the first agent to run on the long-horizon runtime; soon, more agents across the portfolio will run on it, and customers will be able to build their own long-horizon agents.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fagentforce-job-ready-ai-agents%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=JIDX&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


An A+ Announcement:


This year, approximately 100 students will come to Dreamforce for hands-on mentoring and workshops, and Salesforce is announcing $27 million in new education grants nationwide. The grants include $18 million directly supporting public school districts in San Francisco, Oakland, New York City, Chicago, and Indianapolis.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F14%2F27-million-in-new-education-grants-announcement%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=9l5l&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Attennnntion!


Salesforce has launched the Missionforce Military Fellowship, a 12-week Department of War SkillBridge program that helps transitioning service members translate military experience into careers in AI and technology. Fellows receive hands-on training, mentorship, and Salesforce certification support alongside Missionforce teams.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fmissionforce-military-fellowship-announcement%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=eGA7&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Have an Ace Flight:


Air travelers need timely information about what to expect at security, how to prepare for checkpoints, and what to do during busy or disrupted travel periods. To give travelers that support and guidance, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has deployed Ace, an AI agent built on Agentforce Public Sector. It handles 100,000 traveler conversations each month and resolves 96% of routine inquiries without escalation.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F14%2Ftsa-improves-travel-experience-agentforce%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=aTUW&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Opening Gambit:


Salesforce’s Agentforce 360 powers the future of chess, and fans will experience this transformation first-hand through the Chess Concierge Agent, which answers questions on ratings, rules, and live tournament status for 1.2 million monthly visitors in any language. Internally, Agentforce 360 will help the International Chess Federation more efficiently run its operations. This includes powering Move of the Day: a workflow that analyzes moves from elite competition and surfaces them to the FIDE expert panel via Slack for final selection.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F09%2F10%2Fagentforce-360-powers-future-of-chess-with-fide%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=7zn1&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Patrick Stokes, President, Applications & Marketing, Salesforce goes head to head with FIDE's interactive chess AI agent.


A Shared Understanding:


Salesforce is bringing together six capabilities spanning context, agency, action, governance, security, and models, delivered through a common, composable architecture and built on the customer relationships, processes, and controls already running the business. A new AI Control Plane gives businesses one place to see, manage, and control agents and AI as they spread across the enterprise. Customers can use the capabilities together as one system or pick and choose only what they need.


[Read more](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fenterprise-ai-harness%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=kqWg&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


.


Proud moment for our Healthcare team:


Salesforce has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Healthcare Provider Industry Cloud Platforms. We believe this recognition reflects what we hear from health systems every day: care teams need less admin work and more time with patients.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fgartner-magic-quadrant-healthcare-provider-industry-cloud-platforms-2026%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=7L9X&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Claudeforce:


Salesforce and Anthropic unveiled Claudeforce, an expanded partnership that pairs Claude’s reasoning with Salesforce’s trusted enterprise data, workflows, and governance to power agentic experiences inside Claude Cowork. The rollout starts with Salesforce in Claude, giving sales teams direct access to CRM data and actions like meeting prep and pipeline review from inside Claude. An open beta is coming this month, with more prebuilt skills landing soon.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fpress-releases%2F2026%2F08%2F26%2Fsalesforce-and-anthropic-announce-claudeforce%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=utNZ&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Agents Take the Wheel:


The Winter '27 Release marks a fundamental shift in how AI agents operate within the enterprise. Instead of assisting employees one task at a time, agents now run entire workflows — qualifying pipeline, resolving service cases, booking appointments, underwriting risk.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fwinter-2027-product-release-announcement%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=j8LH&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Introducing Slack Code:


With Slack Code, when you have an idea or need to build a new feature, update a web page, or fix a bug, you tag in a coding agent, like Claude Tag or ChatGPT, and it spins up a code channel to tackle the task. Everyone in the channel can see the conversation, review code diffs, check live previews, give feedback, and approve the work before it ships. No specialized tools, no leaving Slack.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fintroducing-slack-code%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=jQ5B&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


3 Keys to Success:


For this year’s Customer Success Award winners, a pattern emerged: start with a specific problem, build a solid data foundation, and get people on board. See how Tottenham created a single “golden record” for millions of fans; how The Grout Guy built a photo-analyzing agent that cut quote turnaround from days to minutes; and how Sammons Financial Group paired an empathetic agent with strong internal buy-in to handle over 16,000 policy calls in six months without adding staff.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fcustomer-success-award-winners-2026%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=s_zD&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Simpler, Faster, Better:


Salesforce is launching new Core, Advanced, and Max editions for Agentforce Sales, Agentforce Service, and Agentforce Industries, bringing together the AI, security, analytics, collaboration, and support that businesses need to start and scale their agentic transformation into a single purchase.


[Read more and get pricing details.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fsalesforce-simplifies-editions-2026%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=aLiu&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Smarsh Gets Results With Two Agentforce Agents:


Smarsh helps regulated organizations capture and act on digital communications to stay ahead of risk. Its customer support agent built on Agentforce, named Archie, now resolves more than 7 in 10 sessions without a human; its internal counterpart, Emmy, launched in March and hit 65% adoption among support reps by June, resolving 31% of cases with AI and saving an average of 7.5 hours per case.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esmarsh%2Ecom%2Fpress-release%2Fsmarsh-scales-salesforces-agentforce-after-delivering-strong-customer-support-results%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=OkxB&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Agentic Enterprise City showcases real journeys of companies who have gone agentic.


Forecasting the Future with Moirai:


LLMs are good at predicting the next word, but they’re not that good at predicting the future. Salesforce’s industry-leading time series model, Moirai, helps companies predict, say, how they will need to staff their contact centers in the face of events like holiday surges. In testing, Moirai delivered 14% greater accuracy on understaffing and nearly 40% greater accuracy on overstaffing during the holiday period, allowing companies to optimize their payroll spending.


[Watch the video](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fvideo%2Fmastering-time-series-forecasting-with-morai%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=E3LX&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


.


Agentic Engineering at Scale:


Scaling agentic coding to 15,000 engineers tested Salesforce's ability to absorb change as much as it tested the technology itself. Salesforce President & CTO, Product Engineering & Research Muralidhar Krishnaprasad describes how the engineering organization became fully agentic.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fagentic-shift-for-salesforce-engineers%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=ffi4&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


CFO Research:


A Salesforce survey of 865 finance leaders finds nearly three-quarters say their role expanded in the past year, and managing AI use and expansion is the top-cited reason. Rising revenue complexity is straining finance teams, but AI is one place finance leaders are finding relief: 90% who use it report ROI, but adoption stays cautious, with security, governance, and cost as top-named blockers.


[Read more.](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Esalesforce%2Ecom%2Fnews%2Fstories%2Fcfos-ai-agents-to-tame-revenue-complexity%2F%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dsfnewsaw&urlhash=Irx3&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)


Three Slack Agent Trends:


The era of switching tabs to talk to your AI agents is over. Data shows that third-party AI agents are exploding in Slack, and marketplace AI apps like Claude reached 362,000 installs; weekly active users on these third-party agents jumped almost 60% quarter over quarter.


[Watch the full video to explore all three trends.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/agentic-trends-in-slack-ugcPost-7503151676858613760-rCxS/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAa0wRMBle3rOr1VMwTutKt8qCKXGmKW-k0&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)
